name: The Glass Bridge
desc:
Welcome to the basic representation of the glass bridge in the Netflix show "Squid Game". The fifth game, known as The Glass Stepping Stones. Don't forget to leave a like if you enjoyed this game. It really helps out! You can also support me through in-game donations! Thank you :3

🎯 Cross the bridge
- Carefully step across the glass tiles and make it in time before the timer runs out!

🛠️ Glass Mechanism
- If too many people step on the same tile, it will break once the limit is reached!

🏆 Explore multiple badges
- Earn special badges as you progress through the game!

🎪 Play the rare modified bridges
- Watch out for events! They can modify the bridge!
